concept: It's okay to say 'I was wrong' when you find out something new
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character was sure of something, discovers it was wrong, and handles that discovery with curiosity instead of embarrassment
exercise.reflection_prompt: How did the character feel about being wrong? What made it okay?
exercise.practice: Student shares a time they found out they were wrong about something small

assessment.success_marker: student shares a real or imagined example without framing being wrong as shameful
